title: ESG Rating Competition and Rating Quality

scopes.description: Complete supplied R workflow: code1 prepares the samples, code2 runs the main difference-in-differences analyses, and code3 runs the additional, staggered, stacked, cross-sectional, and real-activity analyses in the same session.

requirements.description: Annual Compustat fundamentals for the firm-year panel. The code uses GVKEY, fiscal year, assets, equity, shares, current/long-term debt, income, sales, and fiscal-year price to form market capitalization, market-to-book, leverage, and ROE; ROE needs a one-year lag of equity. The supplied COMP.FUNDA candidate has a one-row field/readability check, but full history, return data, and construction of ceq_lag are not established.

routes.description: The catalog and bounded probe support the named annual fundamentals file and the listed source columns. The one-row probe does not establish 2007–2017 coverage or the prior-year history and ceq_lag construction needed by the code.
routes.expected_period: Annual firm-years covering the supplied analyses (2007–2017), plus at least one prior fiscal year for ceq_lag; complete coverage unverified.

requirements.description: The pre-existing sic_US firm-year object joined on GVKEY and fiscal year supplies SIC and is used to exclude selected industries. Its product, fields, history, and construction are not identified by the supplied sources.

issues.description: All three scripts operate on pre-existing in-memory objects. The README describes the stage sequence, but the package lacks the input loaders/object constructors and the product-to-field/key/date mappings needed to reconstruct those objects. Several required outputs also depend on unspecified one-year equity lag, annual identity crosswalks, and a two-year RepRisk lead window. A full prepared analysis panel is absent, so no analysis_only scope is supported.
The documented manual ASSET4–KLD detailed-metric match is required to create the ratingcomponent object consumed in code1, but its matched rows and matching rules are not included.

The R analysis calls dplyr verbs, rowSds from matrixStats, felm, ebalance, and Winsorize. R 4.5.0 is available, but a metadata-only installed-package check found dplyr, matrixStats, lfe, ebal, and DescTools absent. The package-provider/version setup for ebalance and Winsorize is not pinned in the supplied scripts.

evidence.quote:
“code1_data cleaning” - construct the difference-in-difference samples from the initial datasets including company fundamentals and ESG ratings of the incumbents. Three samples are constructed: one for the rating disagreement test, one for the news predictability test, and one for the rating metrics test. The corresponding entropy balanced samples are also constructed.

"code2_main DiD" - after running the first part, this part conducts the basic Difference-in-Difference analyses, where only the initial coverage by Sustainalytics is used as the shock.

"code3_additional" - this part covers all the other tests, including staggered and stacked DID, cross-sectional tests, and other additional tests.
evidence.description: README states code1 constructs samples, code2 runs the main difference-in-differences analyses, and code3 runs additional tests.

evidence.quote:
regsummary <- function(model) {
  model_summary <- summary(model)
  
  
  n_obs <- nobs(model) 
  
  cat("Coefficients:\n")
  print(model_summary$coefficients)
  
  cat("\nR-squared:", model_summary$r.squared, "\n")
  cat("Adjusted R-squared:", model_summary$adj.r.squared, "\n")
  cat("Number of Observations:", n_obs, "\n")
}
